1º de Primaria · Inglés

Hello! Greetings and names

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

A new girl comes to your class. She is from London. What do you say?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

You say Hello! Then you ask What's your name? She says My name is Emma.

2

Aprende12 apartados

Para empezar: A new friend

It is Monday. Leo is at school. A new girl comes into the classroom.

She has a red bag and a big smile.

«Hello!», says Leo. «Hi!», says the girl.

«What's your name?», asks Leo. «My name is Emma. What's your name?»

«I'm Leo. How are you, Emma?» «I'm fine, thank you!»

At the end of the day, Emma waves her hand. «Goodbye, Leo! See you tomorrow!» Now Leo has a new friend.

1. Hello! Hi!

When we meet someone, we say Hello!

We can also say Hi! It is short and friendly.

Say hello to your teacher. Say hi to your friends. Wave your hand and smile!

Vídeo: Hello Song for Kids: greeting song · The Singing Walrus (YouTube) · 194,2 millones de visualizaciones

2. Good morning!

In the morning we say Good morning!

The sun is up. We get up and go to school.

When you arrive at school, say: Good morning, teacher! Your teacher says: Good morning, children!

3. Good afternoon and good night

After lunch we say Good afternoon!

At bedtime we say Good night! The moon and the stars are in the sky.

Say good night to your family. Then close your eyes and sleep.

4. What's your name?

To know a name, we ask: What's your name?

We answer: My name is… and say our name.

For example: My name is Lucía. We can also say I'm Lucía. Ask three friends their names!

Vídeo: What's Your Name? (Sesame Street & Super Simple Songs) · Super Simple Songs (YouTube) · 91 millones de visualizaciones

5. Nice to meet you!

When we meet a new friend, we say Nice to meet you!

The friend answers: Nice to meet you, too!

We can shake hands or give a high five. It is a happy way to start a friendship.

6. How are you?

To ask about feelings, we say How are you?

We can answer: I'm fine, thank you! or I'm happy!

If we are not well, we say I'm sad or I'm tired. It's OK to say how you feel.

7. How old are you?

To ask about age, we say How old are you?

We answer with a number: I'm six. or I'm seven.

Show the number with your fingers. Six is five fingers and one more!

8. Please and thank you

Kind words are magic words.

When we ask for something, we say please. When someone gives us something, we say thank you.

The answer to thank you is You're welcome!

9. Sorry!

If we hurt someone by mistake, we say Sorry!

The other person can say That's OK!

Saying sorry makes friends happy again. It is a very important word in every language.

10. Goodbye! See you!

When we leave, we say Goodbye! or Bye-bye!

If we will see the person soon, we say See you tomorrow! or See you later!

Wave your hand. Bye-bye!

Vídeo: Goodbye Song for kids · The Singing Walrus (YouTube) · 95,4 millones de visualizaciones

11. Game: the name ball

Stand in a circle. Throw a soft ball to a friend.

Say: Hello! What's your name? Your friend catches it and says: My name is…

Then your friend throws the ball. Play until everybody says their name!

12. Review: I can say hello!

Now you can say hello and goodbye.

You can say good morning and good night. You can ask What's your name? and How are you?

You know the magic words: please, thank you and sorry. Well done!

Lo hacemos juntos · Let's do it together

Say hello and your name.

  1. Wave your hand and smile.
  2. Say: Hello!
  3. Say: My name is… and your name.

Resultado: Hello! My name is Pablo.

Ask a friend how he is.

  1. Look at your friend.
  2. Ask: How are you?
  3. Listen: I'm fine, thank you!

Resultado: How are you? I'm fine, thank you!

It is 9 o'clock in the morning. Greet your teacher.

  1. It is the morning.
  2. We say Good morning.

Resultado: Good morning, teacher!

Your friend gives you a crayon. What do you say?

  1. Someone gives you something.
  2. Use a magic word.

Resultado: Thank you!

Errores típicos

  • Saying «Good night» to say hello in the evening: good night is for bedtime.
  • Answering «My name is six»: for age we say «I'm six».
  • Forgetting «please» when we ask for something.
  • Reading «Hello» with a strong h like Spanish j: it is a soft «h», like breathing out.

PracticaResponde sin mirar arriba. Equivocarse aquí también enseña.

Ejercicios (22)

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

Nivel básico

  1. Say hello to your teacher.

    Ver solución
    Hello! / Good morning, teacher!

  2. Say goodbye to a friend.

    Ver solución
    Goodbye! / Bye-bye!

  3. Draw a sun. Write: Good morning!

    Ver solución
    A sun and the words «Good morning!».

  4. Draw a moon. Write: Good night!

    Ver solución
    A moon and the words «Good night!».

  5. Say your name in English.

    Ver solución
    My name is… (your name).

  6. What do you say when someone gives you a present?

    Ver solución
    Thank you!

  7. Wave your hand and say bye-bye.

    Ver solución
    Bye-bye!

  8. Match: Hello – Hola, Goodbye – Adiós.

    Ver solución
    Hello = hola; Goodbye = adiós.

Nivel medio

  1. Complete: What's your ____?

    Ver solución
    name.

  2. Complete: My ____ is Ana.

    Ver solución
    name.

  3. Answer: How are you?

    Ver solución
    I'm fine, thank you! / I'm happy!

  4. Answer: How old are you?

    Ver solución
    I'm six. / I'm seven.

  5. It is 4 o'clock in the afternoon. What do you say?

    Ver solución
    Good afternoon!

  6. Order the words: name / your / What's / ?

    Ver solución
    What's your name?

  7. You push a friend by mistake. What do you say?

    Ver solución
    Sorry!

  8. Your friend says «Thank you!». What do you answer?

    Ver solución
    You're welcome!

  9. Draw your face and write how you feel: I'm happy / I'm sad / I'm tired.

    Ver solución
    A face and one sentence, for example «I'm happy».

Nivel avanzado

  1. Make a short dialogue with a friend: hello, name, how are you, goodbye.

    Ver solución
    Hello! What's your name? My name is… How are you? I'm fine, thank you. Goodbye!

  2. Introduce a toy: «This is my teddy. His name is…».

    Ver solución
    This is my teddy. His name is Max.

  3. Write three magic words in English.

    Ver solución
    Please, thank you, sorry.

  4. Ask three people at home «How are you?» and write their answers.

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: Mum: I'm fine. Dad: I'm tired.

  5. Sing a hello song and teach it to your family.

    Ver solución
    Free answer: sing and share the song.

Explícalo con tus palabrasComo si se lo contaras a alguien de un curso menor

¿Has nombrado estas ideas?
★

Situación de aprendizajeWelcome to our class!

A new child is coming to our class from England. We prepare a welcome in English.

Pasos

  1. We practise Hello, What's your name? and How are you? in pairs.
  2. Each child makes a name badge: My name is…
  3. We make a big Welcome! poster with drawings.
  4. We act out the welcome: greet, ask the name and say goodbye.

Producto final: A welcome poster and a short role-play in English.

Cómo se valora

  • Says hello and goodbye clearly.
  • Asks and says names correctly.
  • Uses please, thank you and sorry.

Glosario

Hello
A word to greet someone (hola).
Goodbye
A word to say when you leave (adiós).
Good morning
A greeting for the morning (buenos días).
Good afternoon
A greeting for after lunch (buenas tardes).
Good night
Words for bedtime (buenas noches).
Name
What people call you (nombre).
Please
A kind word to ask for something (por favor).
Thank you
A kind word when you get something (gracias).
Sorry
A word when you make a mistake (perdón).
Friend
A person you like and play with (amigo, amiga).

Tarjetas de repasoToca la tarjeta para darle la vuelta

Según cómo respondas, la tarjeta vuelve mañana, en 3, en 7 o en 21 días.

Para familias

  • Saludad en inglés al levantaros y al acostaros: Good morning! Good night!
  • Cantad juntos una canción de saludo (hay varias en los vídeos del tema).
  • Usad las palabras mágicas en inglés durante una comida: please, thank you.
  • Jugad a presentar peluches: «Hello! My name is Teddy».

Para profesores

Saberes: Lengua extranjera (Inglés): comprensión y producción oral de saludos, despedidas, presentaciones, estados de ánimo y fórmulas de cortesía; rutinas comunicativas en el aula (RD 157/2022, primer ciclo de Educación Primaria).

  • Rutina diaria de saludo con canción y pregunta «How are you?» con caritas.
  • Juego de la pelota de los nombres en círculo.
  • Role-play de bienvenida a un compañero nuevo.
  • Cartel de «magic words» en la pared de clase.

Fuentes y revisión

  • Real Decreto 157/2022, enseñanzas mínimas de la Educación Primaria (BOE)

Revisado el 14 de noviembre de 2026.

Qué vas a aprender

  • Say hello and goodbye
  • Say good morning, good afternoon and good night
  • Ask and say names: What's your name? My name is…
  • Ask and answer How are you?
  • Say please, thank you and sorry

Palabras clave

hello · hi · goodbye · good morning · good night · What's your name? · My name is… · How are you? · please · thank you

Tiempo

50 minutos hoy + 2 minutos en cada repaso
